summary: Tiered discount ladder applied inconsistently across multi-currency invoice lines
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports that their monthly invoice (Feb 2026) shows inconsistent application of tiered volume discounts when usage is billed across EUR and USD regions. The invoice appears to have applied the discount ladder on a per-line basis after currency conversion, instead of aggregating usage across lines prior to discount calculation. This resulted in an over-credit to the customer in EUR lines and an under-credit in USD lines, producing a net discrepancy and customer confusion.

Requested outcome: clear explanation of calculation, a corrected invoice or credit, and a permanent fix to prevent recurrence.
impact: Customer-facing billing discrepancy affecting revenue recognition and forecast; Brightline flagged with finance and paused automated payments pending clarification. Estimated discrepancy ~€9,760. Customer requests expedited review and credit if appropriate.
environment: prod | multi-region billing (eu-west, us-east) | billing-service v3.4.1 | currency-converter-service v2.1.0
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer runs multi-region batch embedding workload in eu-west and us-east pooled under a single org for February 2026.
2) Usage postbacks arrived with region tags and per-line usage quantities (eu-west lines in EUR, us-east lines in USD).
3) Billing aggregator constructed invoice lines by region and applied tiered discount ladder per line after converting regional subtotals to the invoice base currency (EUR).
4) Expected behavior: aggregate usage across all regions, apply discount ladder to the aggregated usage, then split allocation per region for display and accounting.

investigation_notes: Hypothesis: Discount ladder was being evaluated after currency conversion due to a refactor in billing-aggregator (v3.4.1) that changed call ordering between currency-converter and discount-engine.

Reproduction: Unit test shows discount change when reversing conversion/aggregation order. Aggregated usage 1,240,000 tokens -> discount 15% expected. Per-line application produced effective blended discount 12.3%.

Root cause: billing-aggregator v3.4.1 updated to normalize line currencies early for tax/display reasons; side effect was passing already-converted subtotals into discount-engine, which uses ladder thresholds based on raw usage units (tokens). No conversion invariant enforced in discount-engine.

Risk assessment: Medium-high for multi-currency orgs with usage near ladder thresholds. Edge-case occurs when multiple regions push different lines across adjacent ladder steps after conversion rounding.
Workarounds considered: a) Recompute aggregated usage in base units before calling discount-engine (preferred); b) Post-invoice manual adjustment and credit (temporary).
resolution: Hotfix merged to billing main: aggregator now computes aggregated usage in native units then calls discount-engine, then applies currency conversion for display and line allocation. Issued provisional credit to Brightline for EUR 9,760.00 and generated corrected invoice PDF. Deployed patch to prod 2026-03-12 16:02:00Z with smoke tests. Follow-ups: add unit tests that cover multi-currency ladder edge cases and add monitoring alert when rounded-per-line discount delta > 0.5%.
